workflow.description: Generate song audio from an approved artist/collective prompt through a paid music provider.
Create a SkyeMusicNexus release with artistId, collectiveId, rights/AI disclosure, audio asset pointer, and review state.
Generate clean feed copy, caption hooks, artwork brief, short-form prompts, and storefront product copy.
Post the approved release/content to the Nexus feed as the artist, tagged with Gray Gang.
Create a digital song product on the artist storefront with price, fulfillment type, and SkyePay checkout route.
Before payout release, require artist collective membership paperwork, AI music disclosure if applicable, revenue split, and owner approval.
